# Discussion questions

- What are the limitations of these sytems given their training data? Is the information needed actually in the training data?
- What is the point of citation, practically as well as ethically? 
- How does a collaboratively built resource such as Wikipedia, or a peer-reviewed academic resource, differ from generative AI tools such as ChatGPT or Perplexity AI? (from LD)
